glosses: To bother, harass, or annoy persistently.

examples.text: He pestered me with questions.

glosses: To crowd together thickly.

examples.text: That which eſpecialleſt nouriſht the moſt prime pleaſure in me, was after a ſtorme when they were driuen inſwarmes, and lay close peſtred together as thicke as they could packe; the next day following, if it were faire, they would cloud the whole skie with canuas, by ſpreading their drabled ſailes in the full clue abroad a drying, and make a brauer ſhew with them, then ſo many banners and ſtreamers diſplayed againſt the Sunne on a mountaine top.

examples.text: The way you keep eating raw meat, you're just begging to get tapeworms.
